description: User creation rules: valid input creates an active account; validation, duplicate email and unknown role are refused.

cases.inputs: FullName: "Nguyễn Thư Ký"; Email: "thuky@trustcabinet.local"; Password: "MatKhau@2026!"; RoleId: role "Thành viên".
cases.log: Account row added; audit row UserCreated (actor = admin, details { email, fullName, roleId, role } and no password); log "Account {UserId} created by {ActorId}."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers; roles "Quản trị viên" and "Thành viên" exist.
No account uses the email thuky@trustcabinet.local.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG07) with the new account: active, role "Thành viên"; the password is stored only as a hash.

cases.inputs: FullName: "  Nguyễn Thư Ký  "; Email: "  thuky@trustcabinet.local  "; Password: "MatKhau@2026!"; RoleId: valid.
cases.log: Account row added; audit row UserCreated.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers; roles "Quản trị viên" and "Thành viên" exist.
No account uses the email thuky@trustcabinet.local.
cases.return: UserResult Success (MSG07); name and email are saved trimmed.

cases.return: UserResult InvalidInformation (MSG09) with errors[fullName] = "Họ tên không được để trống."; nothing is saved.

cases.inputs: Email: "THUKY@trustcabinet.local" (different case); other fields valid.
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers; roles "Quản trị viên" and "Thành viên" exist.
An account with email thuky@trustcabinet.local already exists.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(DuplicateEmail) (MSG08): the email is unique regardless of case; nothing saved.

cases.inputs: Email: "thuky@trustcabinet.local"; other fields valid.
cases.log: Log "Create rejected: email already taken (unique index)."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers; roles "Quản trị viên" and "Thành viên" exist.
Email is free when checked, but a concurrent request inserts the same email before this save.
cases.return: UserResult Failure(DuplicateEmail) (MSG08): the unique index violation is answered like the duplicate check; no audit row.

cases.inputs: RoleId: the deleted role; other fields valid.
cases.log: Log "Create rejected: the chosen role was deleted meanwhile."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers; roles "Quản trị viên" and "Thành viên" exist.
The chosen role is deleted by another administrator after it was read and before the insert.
cases.return: UserResult InvalidInformation (MSG09) with errors[roleId] = "Vai trò không tồn tại."; no account is created.

precondition: Admin actor with user-management capability; roles seeded.
